items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I met three buddies of mine, the Three Dukes.

ctx.x: So you were getting a bit worried.

Well, no, not really, because I knew the boat was in and I had the passes. So in the meantime, Willie Lewis was working at Den Haag in the Tabaris. I went over there. Three buddies of mine were going... I met three buddies of mine, the Three Dukes. One of the Three Dukes was playing piano, because he had no piano player. They asked me if I wanted to stay and play them! [LAUGHS] "No!" It was a great temptation. I said, "Why don't you get Nick(?) (?)?" -- the Dutch pianist. Well, they couldn't get him; I don't know…
